secrets._comment: How scripts/resolve-secret.js finds credentials. 'auto' tries env -> OS keychain -> password-manager CLI (op/bw). Pin one: env | keychain | 1password | bitwarden.

notify._comment: How autonomous/scheduled runs reach you (scripts/notify.js). Set 'channel' to one of: email | telegram | discord | slack | stdout. PREFERRED: for discord/slack set 'webhookSecret' to a secret NAME resolved at runtime by scripts/resolve-secret.js (env var / OS keychain / op / bw) so no raw URL sits in this file. A raw 'webhook' URL still works but belongs in gitignored machine.json ONLY — never here.

capabilities._comment: Auto-written by scripts/detect-capabilities.js (also run by bootstrap) — do NOT hand-edit. Records which CLIs/runtimes this machine has, so CLI-first degrades gracefully. Shape per tool: { present, version, path }.
